content.prompt: These two triangles are equiangular. Find $x$.

answer.worked:
Equiangular triangles are similar, so corresponding sides have equal ratios.
$$\begin{align*}\frac{x}{8}&=\frac{9}{6}\\x&=\frac{9}{6}\times8\\&=12\text{ cm}\end{align*}$$

classification.difficultyReason: Match corresponding sides from the angle marks (the 8 cm side opposite the single-arc angle), then solve one proportion.
